title: DirectEntry
description: A Minecraft mod that can skip experimental check when enter a world.
body:
#Intruduction:
This is a Minecraft mod that can skip experimental check when enter a world.

#Warning:
The mod's method of bypassing the 'experimental warning' can be described as **forcible and aggressive.**
Since **no checks** are performed during the creation and loading of the world, please **consider carefully** before installing this mod!

#See the demonstration in Gallery.
